messages:
people-ops: Quick kit: 'Goal Handshake' scripts for smooth owner transitions and concise self-review prompts. Copy-paste friendly. :handshake:

people-ops: Handoff checklist (paste in PR/issue):
- Owner: [name] ; Goal: [one-line outcome]
- Success metric: [metric + target] ; Deadline: [date]
- Known risks: [brief]
- Next step owner + due: [name] / [date]

people-ops: Short manager script to align on handoff (30s):
```
Manager: "Quick handshake 5 - who will own this, what success looks like, and what support you need from me?"
IC: "I'll own rollout; success = <metric> hit by <date>; need 2 design reviews and infra quota."
```

people-ops: Self-review starter (one-liners people can reuse):
- "Led X feature: shipped AB test; metric Y improved by Z%; owned rollout docs."
- "Coached two engineers on perf debugging; reduced incidents week-over-week."

people-ops: Peer feedback micro-prompts (for async asks):
- "Can you give 1 sentence on impact and 1 sentence on collaboration for [name]'s work on [project]?"

rachel_m: Love the handoff checklist. Can we add a tiny 'what success looks like' template for managers to paste into calibration notes?

devin: Also please add a 1:1 minute-by-minute micro-agenda for promotion-readiness check. Keeps things tight.

people-ops: Added: Calibration note snippet: "Candidate goal: [one-line]. Evidence: PRs / dashboard / decision log. Readiness: on-track / needs stretch / not ready."

people-ops: 1:1 micro-agenda (15 min):
- 2m: quick status + metric
- 6m: artifact walkthrough
- 4m: gaps & support
- 3m: next steps + confirm artifacts for calibration

hr-bot: note: saved to /people-ops/goal-handshake-kit (private).

rachel_m: Great — I'll use this in handoffs and promo conversations.

devin: Saved; will use the peer prompt for async feedback. :thumbsup:
